notes.title: Patch FIx for Broken Skeletons
notes.notes: This fixes the skeletons in Andor as being invisible with only clubs shown.

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch Fix
notes.notes:
Multiplayer games had an issue with clients taking over the host.  The host also would respawn instead of taking back over their previous location.  Both have been fixed!

Also updated the game icon to match the new look.  Enjoy!
